title: Graphic Approach
slide_intent: Translate the geometry of a symbol into rules for framing information. The repetition can make a button, a search field and a content card feel related.
strategic_value: Instacart can carry the carrot’s sharp and round corners into useful interface parts even where the complete mark does not appear.
demonstration: An annotated carrot at left leads to three UI examples at right: a rounded Claim Offer control, a rectangular search field and an Order Complete card. Blue guides pick out the corners and curves.
practical_value: Choose a frame treatment by comparing a UI element’s corners with the annotated symbol. Apply the relationship to the container as well as to the control.

content_islands.name: Shape origin
content_islands.spec: Place the brief at left and enlarge the carrot near the middle. Use thin blue guides to mark round and straight features.

content_islands.name: Control examples
content_islands.spec: Draw an arrow toward the right-hand examples. Stack the pill and search field with their construction marks visible.

content_islands.name: Content frame
content_islands.spec: Place the larger order card beneath the controls. Show its heading and gray image area, and circle the upper-right corner treatment.
